description: About us UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies. Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha. At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way. Your mission You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions. Your profile You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university. You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro). You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals. You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop. You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it. You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required. How we work We are an AI-powered development team . Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write. Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you. Potential Research Directions These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads. 1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot. 2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data. 3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several. Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events. Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship. Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions. Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on. AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly. Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively. Interested? Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you! We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability. title: Technical Project Manager
description: THE LAST FRONTIER The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure. ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy. We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to. Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk. ABOUT THE ROLE Our engineering team is expanding rapidly, and we’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to sit at the heart of it, driving delivery across our engineering portfolio. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast, and can bring order to multiple complex, multi-disciplinary hardware projects without slowing them down. You'll be responsible for planning, tracking, and de-risking delivery across products at varying stages of maturity - from early-TRL prototypes through to fielded, mission-ready systems - and from field-ready energy systems to autonomous surface and sub-surface platforms. WHAT YOU’LL DO Own project planning and delivery tracking across concurrent engineering projects and work streams (firmware, electronics, mechanical, testing), translating product strategy and portfolio priorities into executable projects with clear milestones, owners, and outcomes. Convert ambitious commercial and operational deadlines into realistic, resourced delivery plans — holding the line on both ambition and delivery discipline. Maintain visibility across work streams, dependencies, risks, decisions, and resourcing gaps, managing technical risk and dependency mapping across products at different Technology Readiness Levels (TRL) and adjusting project rigour and testing requirements accordingly. Take ownership of BOMs for any existing and future products, manage key supplier relationships and keep track of all materials deliveries. Technical Expertise: Understand the architecture, dependencies, and technical challenges of hardware design and development. Support engineering teams in resolving technical issues. Ensure compliance with industry standards and government regulations, such as MIL-STD, UK DEFSTAN, and STANAG testing and qualification requirements across the product lifecycle. Act as the connective tissue across engineering, procurement, business development, security, product, commercial, and customers — driving cross-functional alignment and ensuring technical progress, customer commitments, and delivery constraints are understood on all sides. Identify and resolve blockers fast, escalate early and clearly, and provide concise, decision-ready updates on consequential tradeoffs. Build and refine the project management tooling, processes, and reporting cadence as ARD scales — you'll be creating much of this from scratch. Identify missing handoffs and unwritten work, converting them into accountable plans, and facilitate requirements and scope definition with product, customer, and technical owners. Lead pilots, implementations, migrations, rollouts, adoption, and operational handoffs. WHAT YOU’LL BRING Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Computer, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or adjacent discipline - or - experience working in a technical engineering role prior to working as a project manager. 4+ years proven experience in Technical Engineering Project Management across multiple concurrent projects,, delivering complex hardware products, ideally in defence, aerospace, or another regulated hardware environment; and ideally at a range of company maturity stages. Working familiarity with MIL-STD testing standards, UK DEFSTAN, and NATO STANAG requirements, and how these shape project planning and qualification timelines. Comfort operating across a range of TRL levels — from early, rapid prototyping and experimentation through to production-grade delivery — and judgement on how to flex process accordingly. A genuine start-up mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, resourcefulness, and getting hands dirty where needed, rather than waiting for the perfect process. A track record of hitting ambitious deadlines in fast-moving, resource-constrained environments. Strong stakeholder management skills — able to communicate technical risk and progress clearly to both engineers and non-technical leadership. Willingness to travel to remote and extreme environments as part of the role if deemed necessary. DESIRABLE SKILLS Knowledge of environmental and reliability testing (e.g. thermal cycling, vibration, shock) Familiarity of electrical systems to ensure a holistic approach to hardware design Basic understanding of RF systems and components Previous experience working within an R&D workshop Experience with satellite communications, RF hardware, or Arctic/extreme-environment systems. Familiarity with export control considerations (ITAR/EAR, UK export licensing) relevant to dual-use technology. Experience working with or alongside defence primes, MOD, or NATO procurement processes. description: Dein Herz schlägt für visuelles Marketing und du hast Freude daran, wenn deine Kunden mit deiner Hilfe sichtbar besser werden? Aufgaben Onboarding: Du begleitest neue Kunden (Makler, Immobilienfotografen, Bauträger) von der Vertragsunterschrift bis zum ersten begeisternden Video – inklusive Setup, Anbindung und Schulung des Teams. Du behältst im Blick, wie aktiv sie unsere Software nutzen, gehst proaktiv auf sie zu und holst stille Accounts zurück ins Boot. Beratung: Du zeigst nicht nur, welche Buttons man klickt, sondern wie ein Video wirklich verkauft – von der Fotoauswahl bis zur Ausspielung auf Instagram, in der Portalanzeige oder im Exposé. Expansion & Renewal: Du erkennst, wann ein Kunde bereit für mehr ist, sicherst Vertragsverlängerungen und entwickelst Accounts weiter (Upselling, weitere Standorte, weitere Nutzer). Produktentwicklung: Du hörst genau hin, was der Markt braucht, und gibst das Feedback der Makler direkt an unser Entwicklerteam weiter. Skalierung: Du baust mit uns die Basis auf, mit der wir viele Kunden gleichzeitig glücklich machen: Hilfe-Artikel, Tutorial-Videos, Webinare und smarte Prozesse. Qualifikation Service-Mindset: Du willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern verstehen, was Dein Kunde eigentlich erreichen will – und greifst dafür auch gerne selbst zum Hörer. Digitale Affinität: Du musst kein Programmierer sein, aber Du solltest Dich sicher in Web-Apps bewegen und verstehen, warum Video-Content auf Instagram & Co. heute essenziell ist. Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst zuhören, zwischen den Zeilen lesen und komplexe Dinge einfach erklären – auch am Telefon mit Menschen, die nicht digital aufgewachsen sind. Dein Deutsch ist exzellent in Wort und Schrift. Erfahrung: Idealerweise hast Du bereits im Customer Success, Account Management, Support oder in der Immobilienbranche gearbeitet. Talentierte Quereinsteiger mit echtem Gespür für Kunden sind aber ebenso willkommen. Arbeitsweise: Du bist top organisiert, zuverlässig und brauchst niemanden, der Dir jeden Tag Deine To-Dos vorgibt. Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Kunden den Überblick. Benefits Vollzeit oder Teilzeit: Diese Stelle ist auch in Teilzeit möglich (ab 20 Std./Woche). Sag uns einfach in Deiner Bewerbung, welches Modell zu Deinem Leben passt – wir finden gemeinsam eine Lösung. Spannendes Produkt: Du betreust keine trockenen Tabellen, sondern ein visuelles Tool, das Spaß macht und sofort sichtbare Ergebnisse liefert. New Work & Ausstattung: Ob in unserem Büro in Karlsruhe oder im Homeoffice – wir statten Dich komplett aus (Laptop, Headset etc.). Startup-Kultur: Wir sind ein junges Unternehmen ohne Konzern-Politik. Freu Dich auf kurze Entscheidungswege, Duz-Kultur und regelmäßige Team-Events. Karrierechancen: Du baust den Bereich Customer Success bei uns mit auf – mit der Perspektive, eigene Strukturen und später ein eigenes Team zu verantworten. Arbeitsort Alle bei uns arbeiten einen Teil der Woche von zu Hause. Bis dahin dauert es aber etwas: Wir sind ein kleines Team in Karlsruhe und lernen am schnellsten nebeneinander, deshalb sind die ersten ein bis zwei Monate reine Bürozeit. Danach klären wir mit dir, wie deine Woche aussieht. Was wir nicht anbieten können, ist eine Stelle, die von Anfang an aus der Ferne läuft. Wohnst du weiter weg und willst trotzdem, dann schreib uns, wie du die erste Zeit lösen würdest. So bewirbst du dich Ein Lebenslauf sagt wenig darüber, wie jemand redet und erklärt. So bekommen wir einen echten Eindruck von dir, und du einen davon, was dich in der Rolle erwartet. Maximal 5 Minuten, zwei Teile: Zwei Minuten zu dir: wer du bist, was du bisher gemacht hast und warum du zu uns willst. Drei Minuten Praxis: Ein Makler überlegt, ob KI-Videos für seine Objekte taugen, ist aber skeptisch. Erklär ihm, wie marton funktioniert, und nimm ihm seine Bedenken.
